And before we move into each of the businesses, this quarter we've changed the presentation of preferred dividend in our lines of business and show the impact here on the page. For the company, preferred dividends were and continue to be below the line. In order to have cleaner trends and better peer comparability, we're now presenting preferred dividends below the lines for each of our LOBs, which is particularly important given recent increases in preferred issuance. You can see on the slide that the change in methodology has no impact on firm-wide financials nor on LOB returns on equity while LOB revenue, net income and overhead ratios improve, and additionally the adjustment effects to contra- revenue ratio in the CIB. So from here throughout this presentation and also in the supplement, all numbers, in all periods, consistently reflect this change.
